rationale: The pinned source directly states that finite-volume cells in heterogeneous media can receive potentially different material properties through a problem-appropriate averaging of material parameters over each cell's enclosed volume. The fifth repair gives this statement concrete but nonprescriptive content: D009 supplies a genuine measurable partition; D008 supplies a Model-indexed operation tied to its cell regions with the minimal locality and normalization behavior of an average; the theorem fixes an actual model and field; and its witness assigns exactly the selected per-cell values, preserves cell-local dependence, and records actual cell-to-cell difference. Because the averaging formula remains an external problem-specific choice, the theorem neither substitutes an arbitrary appropriateness proposition nor forces one Bochner mean. Both semantic implication directions therefore hold in the intended finite-volume setting.
